title: Timeout verdict without waiting for cleanup
goal: gradeCandidate returns a timeout at once and defers workspace removal until the executor resolves
acceptance: An executor that never resolves while its process keeps writing gets a timeout within seconds of timeoutMs
The workspace is removed when the executor resolves, or by removeLeftoverWorkspaces() once the writer stops
privacy: No data: grader control flow only.
validation: Regression test committed failing first; npm test; CI
escalation: A change to the executor contract is an owner decision

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-25 in #99 while reviewing it: deferred cleanup in grade.mjs and a regression test with an endless writer; CI and merge remain. Not a measurement.
